title: Minkowski Decompositions for Generic Infinitesimal Newton-Okounkov Bodies of Arbitrary-Degree External Tensor Products on Products of Curves
summary: Explicit computations of generic infinitesimal Newton--Okounkov bodies are difficult even for varieties with simple product structure. We give an explicit formula in arbitrary dimension for positive-degree external tensor products on products of smooth projective curves.
